nodes.description: msg.sender - caller-controlled address used for authorization and balance bookkeeping
UniswapExchange.transfer(address _to, uint _value) public payable, forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value)
UniswapExchange.transferFrom(address _from,address _to,uint _value) public payable, the core token movement routine
UniswapExchange.ensure(address,uint) internal view whitelist/condition gate
UniswapExchange.delegate(address a, bytes b) public payable, owner-only arbitrary delegatecall
UniswapExchange.init(uint saleNum,uint token,uint maxToken) owner-only sale parameter setter
UniswapExchange.batchSend(address[] _tos,uint _value) owner-only batch transfer
UniswapExchange.setTradeAddress(address addr) owner-only setter for the trade whitelist address
UniswapExchange.approve(address _spender,uint _value) public payable allowance setter
mapping(address=>uint) public balanceOf - token balances
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) public allowance
address private owner - privilege anchor for admin functions
mapping(address=>uint256) private _onSaleNum - per-address sale counter
mapping(address=>bool) private canSale - whitelist bypassing condition()
uint256 private _saleNum - maximum number of sales per address
uint256 private _minSale - minimum transfer amount
uint256 private _maxSale - maximum transfer amount
address tradeAddress - additional whitelisted address in ensure()
balanceOf[_from] -= _value; balanceOf[_to] += _value in transferFrom - raw unchecked arithmetic
a.delegatecall(b) in delegate() - arbitrary external code execution in contract context
address(token).call(data) inside SafeERC20.callOptionalReturn - low-level external call
SafeERC20.callOptionalReturn(IERC20,bytes) private - performs and validates the low-level token call
uint total = _value * _tos.length and balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total - unchecked arithmetic in batchSend
ERC20._transfer(address,address,uint) internal - reference balance mutation using SafeMath
mapping(address=>uint) private _balances in the ERC20 implementation
ERC20._approve(address,address,uint) internal - writes the allowance mapping

edges.reason: transfer() passes msg.sender as the _from argument into transferFrom
transferFrom() compares msg.sender against _from and reads allowance[_from][msg.sender] for authorization
delegate() is gated by require(msg.sender == owner)
init() is gated by require(msg.sender == owner)
batchSend() is gated by require(msg.sender == owner)
setTradeAddress() is gated by require(msg.sender == owner)
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender]
transfer() delegates all work to transferFrom()
transferFrom() calls ensure() as its authorization/limit gate before moving balances
transferFrom() reads and writes balanceOf for both _from and _to
transferFrom() decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender]
transferFrom() increments _onSaleNum[_from] after each transfer
transferFrom() performs raw -= and += on balanceOf without SafeMath
unchecked arithmetic mutates the balanceOf mapping in place
ensure() whitelists the owner address without condition checks
ensure() leads to condition() which reads _onSaleNum[_from]
ensure() reads canSale[_from] as a bypass flag
ensure() calls condition() which reads _saleNum
condition() compares _value against _minSale
ensure() compares _from against tradeAddress for whitelisting
delegate() guards execution with the owner state variable
delegate() executes a.delegatecall(b) with user-supplied target and calldata
init() guards parameter setting with the owner state variable
init() writes the _saleNum state variable
init() computes _minSale = token * 10**decimals
init() computes _maxSale = maxToken * 10**decimals
batchSend() credits balanceOf[_to] for every recipient in the loop
batchSend() guards the batch transfer with the owner state variable
batchSend() computes total = _value * _tos.length and subtracts it without SafeMath
setTradeAddress() guards the whitelist update with the owner state variable
setTradeAddress() writes the tradeAddress state variable used by ensure()
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender]
delegatecall transfers execution to an arbitrary contract, which can reenter the owner-privileged contract in its own storage context
the low-level call hands control to the token contract, which may call back before state is settled
callOptionalReturn() performs the low-level call and checks the success flag
unchecked batchSend arithmetic mutates balanceOf[msg.sender] and the recipients' balances
ERC20._transfer updates the _balances state variable with SafeMath guards
ERC20._approve writes the allowance mapping, mirroring the public approve path
_to parameter is forwarded by transfer() into transferFrom
_from parameter is used by transferFrom() to index balanceOf and allowance
_to parameter is used by transferFrom() as the credit destination
_value parameter is the amount moved by transferFrom()
caller-supplied _value directly feeds the unchecked balanceOf arithmetic
parameter a is the user-supplied delegatecall target address
parameter b is the user-supplied delegatecall calldata
saleNum parameter is stored into _saleNum by init()
token parameter is scaled and stored into _minSale by init()
maxToken parameter is scaled and stored into _maxSale by init()
_tos array parameter drives the batchSend loop and the total computation
_value parameter is credited to each recipient in batchSend
_value is multiplied by _tos.length in the unchecked total computation
addr parameter is written into the tradeAddress whitelist variable
local total holds the unchecked product and is subtracted from balanceOf[msg.sender]
local loop index i controls the batchSend iteration

normalization_plan.reason: _to is a transient argument of transfer() and carries no independent security semantics
_from is only used to index balanceOf/allowance inside transferFrom
_to is only used as the credit destination inside transferFrom
_value is the direct operand of the unchecked balance update in transferFrom
a is the delegatecall target argument and belongs to that unsafe operation
b is the delegatecall calldata argument and belongs to that unsafe operation
saleNum is consumed only to assign _saleNum inside init()
token is consumed only to compute _minSale inside init()
maxToken is consumed only to compute _maxSale inside init()
_tos is consumed only by the batchSend loop and length computation
_value feeds the unchecked multiplication and per-recipient credit in batchSend
addr is consumed only to overwrite the tradeAddress whitelist entry
total is the intermediate result of the unchecked multiplication in batchSend
i is a pure loop counter with no independent security meaning
